resources.string: Stopped · Root/eBPF available; verified again on connect

Grant Root when prompted to try eBPF. Root mode requires Linux TCX egress links (normally 6.6+), BPF helpers, TUN and SELinux permission. It redirects unicast IPv4/IPv6 through the existing sing-box core. Proxy-owned and Android-protected sockets, loopback and local multicast/control traffic are excluded. Unsupported kernels or load/attach failures switch to VPNService automatically. VPN permission is requested in advance to allow fallback. Per-app/process or LAN bypass settings retain VPNService. Use the existing node selector, connection switch and Logs panel; tap the mode label for this explanation.
